blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) distributed ChariTimba food packs to residents of General Mariano Alvarez (GMA), Cavite, on October 19, 2026, at the Gregoria de Jesus Covered Court, as part of its continuing efforts to extend assistance to communities in need. PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes (Ret.) led the distribution, together with PCSO Directors Janet De Leon-Mercado, Jennifer Liongson-Guevara, and Imelda Papin. The activity was conducted upon the request of Cavite 5th District Representative Roy Loyola. In their respective speeches, GMA Mayor Medardo Custodio and Cavite Governor Roy Loyola expressed their gratitude to PCSO for its continued support and […]...
